paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi’s strength was plain for all to see; defeating Katsuie was naturally well within his power. His intention was equally clear: to prevent the realm from plunging into war once more, he had to reach accord with Nagahide. Once that was done, who would dare utter a word against him? He had seized the initiative and brought Nagahide under strategic pressure.
